items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Don and I were old, old friends

ctx.x: Yeah. He… for guitar and string trio or something. And Don and I were old, old friends, and Don… I think I told you. He had been a jazz trumpet player when he was a kid. And then he’s an incredible composer but pretty far out. And it must have been at the Institute of Music because… Anyway, I went there and I played a piece of Don’s for guitar and string quartet or something like that. So after the first rehearsal, the guys or people… I don’t know if they’re all guys or… had this classical piece that had guitar…
